method: The main UI initializer constructs the registered window wrappers after assigning the GameInter resource owner at main+0x1C. The frame/position/size values below are taken from each wrapper call sequence; they are not hand-calibrated preview values.

position_semantics.algorithm: 0x00423B30 selects the WIL header dimensions, derives anchor offsets, and calls SetRect before returning; when its centering/anchor flag is active, the call-site x/y are not themselves final screen origin.
position_semantics.warning: Do not treat every [x,y] in records as a final 800x600 screen coordinate. The final origin must use the constructor branch and anchor mode; records preserve raw inputs so the calculation is reproducible.

initial_visibility_proof.derived_constructor_calls: All 15 registered wrapper paths call 0x00423B30, which initializes the shared window object; ID15 wrapper 0x0043E260 is included.
initial_visibility_proof.interpretation: The shared constructor writes zero to +0x30. The main initializer constructs/registers the windows but has no 0x0042AC30 show-helper call in the registration sequence; normal windows therefore begin hidden and are promoted by the visibility dispatcher only after an explicit command/state path.

notice_id15_open_path.interpretation: The registered Frame 602 object is opened by the notice/result path after 0x0043E4B0 succeeds; the static caller is not a guild-page-only path.
